tasks.question: What does font mean?
Which button allows you to make the selected text bold?
Which button allows you to make the selected text italic?
Which button allows you to underline the selected text?
How do we measure font size?
What does text alignment mean?
How many basic alignment modes are there for paragraphs?
Which alignment has both sides of the text straight?
How can you change the text color?
options: With the font color icon (Letter A with colored stripe below)

tasks.question: What is the 'Highlight' tool for?
options: Gives a colored background like a highlighter pen

tasks.question: What does bulleting mean?
options: Creating a list with dots or numbers

tasks.question: Which key allows you to indent the first line of a paragraph?
What does line spacing mean?
What is a margin?
options: Empty space between the paper edge and text

tasks.question: How can you insert a picture into the document?
In which menu can you find page numbering?
What is the 'Format Painter' for?
options: Copying formatting from one text part to another

tasks.question: In what direction can a sheet of paper be?
What does header mean?
options: The very first word of the document
Repeating text at the top of every page

tasks.question: How can you put a border around a paragraph?
What does the 'Clear all formatting' button do?
options: Resets to the default font style

tasks.question: Which key can quickly zoom the view?
What does the 'Change Case' button (Aa) mean?
options: Modifies case of selected text (e.g. to all caps)

tasks.question: What do we call the note at the bottom of the page?
Why is document formatting important?
options: To make text clearer and more aesthetic

tasks.text: Bold letters help highlight important words.
Text can be aligned to the left, right, or center.
Justified alignment gives an aesthetic look to the text.
Font size is determined in points.
Bullets help make lists more transparent.
Margins provide a frame for the document content.
Italic style is often used for quotes.
Page numbers help with orientation in the document.
The header is a repeating part at the top of the page.
By changing the font we can make the writing unique.
